ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in the Cartesian coordinate system, there is a right-angled triangle $Rt\triangle AOB$, with $\angle ABO=90^\circ$ and $\angle AOB=30^\circ$. The right-angle side $OB$ is on the positive half of the $y$-axis, point $A$ is in the first quadrant, and $OA=1$. Rotate the $Rt\triangle AOB$ counter-clockwise around the origin by $30^\circ$, and at the same time, double the lengths of its sides (i.e., $OA_{1}=2OA$). This results in $Rt\triangle OA_{1}B_{1}$. Similarly, rotate $Rt\triangle OA_{1}B_{1}$ around the origin $O$ counter-clockwise by $30^\circ$, and at the same time, double the lengths of its sides, resulting in $Rt\triangle OA_{2}B_{2}$, ..., Following this rule, we obtain $Rt\triangle OA_{2021}B_{2021}$. What is the length of $OB_{2021}$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} In right triangle $\triangle AOB$, we have $\angle AOB=30^\circ$ and $OA = 1$, \\
therefore, $OB = OA \cdot \cos{\angle AOB} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$, \\
according to the problem, $OB_1 = 2OB = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \times 2$, \\
$OB_2 = 2OB_1 = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \times 2^2$, \ldots \\
$OB_n = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \times 2^n = \sqrt{3} \times 2^{n-1}$, \\
therefore, the length of $OB_{2021}$ is: $\sqrt{3} \times 2^{2020} = \boxed{\sqrt{3} \times 2^{2020}}$.

推理：设 B=(0,b)，因为 OB 在正 y 轴上，且 ∠AOB=30°，OA=1。OB 是 OA 在 y 轴方向上的投影，所以 |OB|=|OA|cos30°=1·√3/2=√3/2。每一次变换都是把从 O 出发的点的位置向量先逆时针旋转 30°，再放大 2 倍；旋转不改变长度，放大使长度变为原来的 2 倍。因此 |OB_n|=2^n|OB|。代入 n=2021，得到 |OB_2021|=2^2021·√3/2=√3·2^2020。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, in the Cartesian coordinate system, there is a right-angled triangle $Rt\triangle AOB$, with $\angle ABO=90^\circ$ and $\angle AOB=30^\circ$. The right-angle side $OB$ is on the positive half of the $y$-axis, point $A$ is in the first quadrant, and $OA=1$. Rotate the $Rt\triangle AOB$ counter-clockwise around the origin by $30^\circ$, and at the same time, double the lengths of its sides (i.e., $OA_{1}=2OA$). This results in $Rt\triangle OA_{1}B_{1}$. Similarly, rotate $Rt\triangle OA_{1}B_{1}$ around the origin $O$ counter-clockwise by $30^\circ$, and at the same time, double the lengths of its sides, resulting in $Rt\triangle OA_{2}B_{2}$, ..., Following this rule, we obtain $Rt\triangle OA_{2021}B_{2021}$. What is the length of $OB_{2021}$?
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} In right triangle $\triangle AOB$, we have $\angle AOB=30^\circ$ and $OA = 1$, \\
therefore, $OB = OA \cdot \cos{\angle AOB} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$, \\
according to the problem, $OB_1 = 2OB = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \times 2$, \\
$OB_2 = 2OB_1 = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \times 2^2$, \ldots \\
$OB_n = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \times 2^n = \sqrt{3} \times 2^{n-1}$, \\
therefore, the length of $OB_{2021}$ is: $\sqrt{3} \times 2^{2020} = \boxed{\sqrt{3} \times 2^{2020}}$
raw_record.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure is a rectangular coordinate system, O is the origin, the x-axis points to the right, and the y-axis points upward. The initial right triangle AOB is located near the origin, OB is the right-angle side from O along the positive y-axis direction, and A is in the first quadrant; the subsequent triangles OA1B1 and OA2B2 rotate counterclockwise around O and gradually become larger, and the figure also shows points such as A1, A2, B1, and B2 appearing in sequence. Then reason: It is known that in Rt△AOB, ∠ABO=90°, ∠AOB=30°, OA=1. Because the right angle is at B, OA is the hypotenuse; OB is the adjacent side of ∠AOB=30°. Therefore OB=OA·cos30°=1·√3/2=√3/2. Each step of transformation rotates the triangle counterclockwise around O by 30°, and at the same time enlarges all side lengths to 2 times the original, so the length OB_n=2^n·OB. Substituting n=2021, obtain OB_2021=2^2021·√3/2=√3·2^2020.
